(\textbf{la politica}.) The economy? (\textbf{l'economia}.) War? (\textbf{la guerra}.) Peace? (\textbf{la pace}.) An army? (\textbf{l'esercito}.) A singer? (\textbf{il cantante}.) A performance? (\textbf{lo spettacolo}.) An actor? (\textbf{l'attore}.) An actress? (\textbf{l'attrice}.) A novel? (\textbf{il romanzo}.)
